meta.title: IntuiFy | Apps, e-commerce and custom software
meta.description: iOS and Android app development, online stores, business software and artificial intelligence. IntuiFy Ventures, S.L., based in Mallorca.
meta.og_image_alt: IntuiFy: apps, e-commerce and custom software for businesses

hero.subtitle: We create digital solutions to sell online, run your business and automate tasks. We stay with you from defining the project to launch, maintenance and improvements.

services.title: Digital solutions for your business
services.intro: We shape every project around your business needs, with a defined scope, a clear budget and technical support along the way.

items.title: Web & e-commerce
items.description: We build websites and online stores that make products, orders and customers easy to manage.
features: Admin panels you can use from your phone

items.title: iOS and Android apps
items.description: We develop mobile apps and handle their preparation, submission and follow-up on the App Store and Google Play.
features: Connection to databases and company systems

items.title: Business software
items.description: We build custom tools to organise information, keep operations under control and reduce manual work.

items.title: Artificial intelligence & automation
items.description: We add artificial intelligence where it brings a concrete improvement to your business.

projects.title: Projects you can see

own_products.title: Our products
own_products.text: IntuiFy also works as a venture builder: we design, launch and run our own products, such as Auterio, BUBBLO and Eco Andratx, which we keep full ownership of. That product experience is what we bring to our clients' projects.
own_products.investors: If you are a strategic partner or investor interested in one of our products, let's talk.
own_products.cta: Talk to us about our products

method.title: From need to launch

steps.title: We understand your project
steps.text: We look at what you need, who will use the solution and which goals it has to meet.

steps.title: We define scope and budget
steps.text: We agree on features, deliverables, timelines and terms before we start.

steps.title: We design and build
steps.text: We build the solution and show you progress at the agreed milestones.

steps.title: We test and launch
steps.text: We check that everything works, put it live and show you how to use it.

steps.title: We maintain and improve
steps.text: We offer maintenance and support on terms defined for each project.

method.note: Timelines depend on the scope and the integrations required.

reasons.title: A technical partner for your business

items.title: Built around you
items.text: We adapt the solution to how your company works, not the other way round.

items.title: One point of contact
items.text: One person follows your project and answers your questions from start to finish.

items.text: Scope, timelines and terms agreed before we start. We work efficiently, with realistic timelines.

items.text: We build our own products and client projects, and bring what we learn to each one.
